info.name: Homestay AI API — Week 4
info.description:
Complete REST API testing collection for the Homestay AI platform (Week 4 — Backend & API Development).

Base URL: http://localhost:5000/api

8 endpoints covering:
• Health check
• Full CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete)
• Search with multi-field filtering
• Featured listings filter

Each request includes saved example responses captured from the live server.

request.description: Verifies the server is running and responsive. Returns server status, timestamp, and current environment.
Returns all listings stored in the in-memory data store. Response includes a count field and the full data array.

query.description: Keyword search — matches title, description, location, and amenities

request.description:
Multi-field search and filter endpoint. Supports query parameters:
• q — keyword search across title, description, location, amenities
• location — filter by location
• minPrice / maxPrice — price range filter
• guests — minimum guest capacity

All parameters are optional and combinable.
